source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: **[Eternity Gate](vsdata:ability/necrons.monolith.eternity-gate)** opens in your [Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase) from round two onward to select a friendly unit with **NECRONS INFANTRY**, either deployed or in [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves). A deployed pick goes into Strategic Reserves first. An [Ingress move](vsdata:core-rule/ingress-move) then lets it arrive entirely within 6″ of the Monolith, with horizontal separation exceeding 8″ from each enemy unit. This can place it in the opponent’s deployment zone. The arriving unit cannot use a [Charge move](vsdata:core-rule/charge-move) until a later turn.

typedMechanics.recipient: one friendly Necrons Infantry unit on battlefield or in Strategic Reserves
